findings.current: “About one or two shichen ago. Since you were deep in qi circulation, I took over for you.”
findings.defect: Mujin says he received Gung Gibang’s message on Taekyung’s behalf, not that he took over Taekyung’s duties.
findings.rationale: 제가 대신 들었습니다 means that Mujin heard or received what Gung Gibang said in Taekyung’s stead. “I took over for you” changes the action and leaves the object unstated.
findings.replacement: “About one or two shichen ago. You were busy circulating your qi, so I took the message for you.”
findings.source: 조장님은 한창 운기조식 중이셔서 제가 대신 들었습니다.

findings.current: “They only went to the marketplace for sweetmeats and dumplings.”
findings.defect: The draft omits Mujin’s incredulous question and Taekyung’s confused reaction, removing the delayed clarification that drives the joke.
findings.rationale: The source deliberately lets Mujin challenge Taekyung’s assumption before revealing that Cheongpung and Gung Gibang have merely gone shopping.
findings.replacement:
“Do they really need to say goodbye when they’re only stepping out for a bit?”

“…?”

“They went to the marketplace for sweetmeats and dumplings.”
findings.source:
“아니, 잠깐 다녀오는데 인사까지 하고 나가야 합니까?”

“……?”

“저잣거리에 당과랑 만두 사러 갔습니다.”

findings.current: It had nothing to do with me beyond that point.
findings.defect: The draft states that the matter had no connection to Taekyung, while the source says only that what happened next was no longer his concern.
findings.rationale: 내가 알 바 없다 expresses dismissal of further responsibility or concern, not an absence of involvement.
findings.replacement: Well, what happened after that was none of my concern.
findings.source: 뭐, 거기까진 내가 알 바 없다.

findings.current: “Forget Big Brother. What about the others? I haven’t seen them anywhere.”
findings.defect: “Big Brother” loses the explicit eldest-brother relationship and reads like a form of direct address rather than a reference to Taekyung’s eldest brother.
findings.rationale: 큰형님 specifically identifies Taekyung’s eldest older brother.
findings.replacement: “Forget my eldest brother. What about the others? I haven’t seen them anywhere.”
findings.source: “그럼 큰형님은 됐고. 다른 사람들은? 통 안 보이네.”

findings.current: Not that the rest of him had remained intact.
findings.defect: The draft generalizes the injury into unspecified bodily damage, losing the source’s concrete but euphemistic statement that a different body part fell off.
findings.rationale: 다른 부분이 떨어져 explicitly describes another part being severed while withholding its name for comic timing.
findings.replacement: It was just a different part that had fallen off instead.
findings.source: 목 대신 다른 부분이 떨어져서 그렇지.

findings.current: He’s seemed pretty busy lately, too. He’s been gathering strange medicinal ingredients, boiling them, chopping them up… He looked like he was in quite a rush.
findings.defect: “Chopping” misrenders 다지고 in the medicinal-preparation context, and “in quite a rush” changes 정신없다 from being overwhelmingly busy to moving hurriedly.
findings.rationale: 다지다 here denotes pounding or crushing medicinal ingredients, while 정신없어 보이다 describes someone looking frantically busy or overwhelmed.
findings.replacement: He’s seemed pretty busy lately, too. He’s been gathering strange medicinal ingredients, boiling them, pounding them… He looked completely swamped.
findings.source: 걔도 요새 좀 바빠 보이던데. 이상한 약재 모아서 끓이고, 다지고, 정신없어 보이더라고요.

findings.current: Without a tank’s protection or cover from a mage or archer, it ultimately became a fight between individuals.
findings.defect: “A fight between individuals” suggests one-on-one combat. The source means that without teammates’ protection or support, survival ultimately becomes a personal fight.
findings.rationale: 개인의 싸움이다 emphasizes having to fend for oneself, not a contest specifically fought between two individuals.
findings.replacement: Without a tank’s protection or cover from a mage or archer, you were ultimately on your own.
findings.source: 탱커의 보호도, 마법사나 궁수의 엄호도 없으면 결국 개인의 싸움이다.

findings.current: Even if I taught you my martial arts, there’s a good chance you wouldn’t be able to absorb them through the formula.
findings.defect: “Absorb them through the formula” is an unnatural calque and obscures that following the formulas would not necessarily let Taekyung internalize Mungyeong’s martial arts.
findings.rationale: 구결에 따라 녹아들지 못하다 concerns the martial arts failing to become integrated or internalized despite following their formulas.
findings.replacement: Even if I taught you my martial arts, there’s a good chance you wouldn’t be able to make them your own merely by following the formulas.
findings.source: 하여 네놈에게 무공을 가르친다 해도, 구결에 따라 녹아들지 못할 가능성이 높다.

findings.current: Try melting those principles into the martial arts you’ve learned.
findings.defect: “Melting those principles into” is an unnatural literal rendering of 녹이다 in this figurative context.
findings.rationale: The source instructs Taekyung to integrate Mungyeong’s principles into his existing martial arts.
findings.replacement: Try incorporating those principles into the martial arts you’ve learned.
findings.source: 그 무리를 네가 익힌 무공에 녹여 보아라.

summary: Two meaningful fidelity defects: Mujin taking a message is changed into assuming Taekyung’s duties, and a line essential to the marketplace misunderstanding is omitted. Several localized wording issues also alter physical detail or produce unnatural English.
